p: Ramathaimzophim: There were two Ramatus, so that in this city in mount Ephraim were Zophim, that is, the learned men and prophets.
Shiloh: For the ark was there at that time.
portion: Some read, a portion with a hearty cheer.
sons: Let this comfort you, that I love you no less than if you had many children.
temple of the LORD: That is of the house where the ark was.
grace in thy sight: That is, pray to the Lord for me.
remembered her: According to her petition.
Elkanah: This Elkanah was a Levite, 1Ch 6:27, and as some write once a year they were accustomed to appear before the Lord with their families.
word: Because her prayer took effect, therefore it was called the Lord's promise.
soul liveth: That is, most certainly.
worshipped the LORD there: Meaning, Eli gave thanks to God for her.
